risks.note: Exposure to macroeconomic slowdowns, global market disturbances, war-related disruptions, geopolitical tensions, inflation spikes and interest-rate hikes, all of which can dampen consumer demand for what is largely a discretionary, housing-linked product basket. Mitigated by diversifying across business segments, optimising cost structures, broadening the customer base and monitoring global developments.

Intensifying competition, particularly from unbranded players, can erode pricing power and compress margins; in kitchen appliances the entry of online-first brands and value-led imports has intensified channel fragmentation and pricing pressure. Mitigated through R&D and product innovation and an omnichannel distribution network.
risks.risk: Competition risk, including from unbranded and online-first players

risks.note: Rapid shifts in consumer preferences may lead to lower adoption of products if the Company fails to adapt, and shorter product lifecycles in appliances demand continuous design innovation. Mitigated by a structured consumer-feedback mechanism that tailors product offerings.

Shifts in buying habits may undermine traditional distribution channels, impacting revenue and profitability — material for a business whose moat is a general-trade dealer and retailer network. Mitigated by an omnichannel strategy combining a strengthened e-commerce presence with continued investment in traditional channels.

Under-utilisation of logistics, retail and support assets, plus unexpected supply chain disruptions, can inflate costs, delay product availability and reduce margins — a live issue given newly commissioned capacity that must be filled. Mitigated by optimising logistics and store operations, automation and a franchise model to improve coverage and resource utilisation.
risks.risk: Operating efficiency and supply chain risk

risks.note: Poor quality can damage sales and brand reputation, and misleading or negative perceptions across media channels can detract from brand equity — a heightened exposure for a six-decade household brand. Mitigated by rigorous quality-control standards with continuous audits and supplier oversight, and integrated communication strategies.
risks.risk: Product quality and brand legacy risk

risks.note: Difficulty securing short- and long-term funds at favourable rates can strain liquidity and hamper operations, while fluctuations in the credit profile can raise the cost of capital or restrict financing access. Mitigated by optimising working-capital cycles, maintaining well-staggered debt maturities and transparent lender/rating-agency relationships.
risks.risk: Credit profile and credit rating risk

risks.note: Volatility in foreign exchange rates can erode profitability on imports and exports; the Company imports raw materials, spare parts and components. Mitigated by hedging strategies including forward and option contracts.
